name: video-trimmer
description: AI-Powered Smart Video Trimmer and rough-cut engine. Features Gemini 3.8 Flash Multimodal Video Understanding (native video, no hallucinated cuts, last-take-wins), Whisper word-level acoustic ground truth, acoustic onset snapping, 20ms audio equal-power micro-crossfade, and multi-format NLE project export (Premiere Pro XML, DaVinci Resolve XML, Final Cut Pro FCPXML).
